question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not support a comparison between “our Oscilloscope solution” and any competitor for Automotive; the only oscilloscope-related fact provided is that R&S FSW-B2071 is an “Oscilloscope baseband inputs” hardware option applicable to all FSW models, with no Automotive or competitor comparison stated [4].
### Evidence required before making the comparison
| To claim | Required evidence | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Our oscilloscope solution is suitable for Automotive | A cited product document, application note, solution note, or test setup that directly connects the oscilloscope solution to Automotive use cases; the current Automotive product evidence is for R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, not an oscilloscope solution [60]. | Automotive fit cannot be inferred from separate product facts; the passages require a cited source directly connecting the relevant comparison facets, and separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. |
| Our oscilloscope solution has specific capabilities | Binding specifications with model, option code, version/date, measurement conditions, tolerance limits, and calibration/environment conditions; formal product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-binding data [49]. | Non-binding data and sales descriptions cannot be used as guaranteed technical claims; CMX500 feature data, for example, is “subject to change” and data without tolerance limits is not binding [49]. |
| Competitor product capabilities | Competitor official datasheets, features documents, configuration guides, release notes, or third-party test reports for the exact competitor model/version; R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [32]. | The passages warn that R&S internal battle-card claims about competitors require official competitor documents or third-party evidence before use in customer material [75]. |
| Any “better than,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” claim | Formal evidence such as datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools, validated test reports, or a documented TCO calculation; battle-card sales language is not a verifiable technical specification [12]. | The passages explicitly say “only,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability,” and “lower TCO” must be checked against formal evidence before technical comparison or customer use [12]. |
| Automotive test coverage or certification | Test report, certificate number, certification body role, test date, standard version, test case IDs, pass/fail criteria, and scope; eCall-related passages note missing certificate numbers, report numbers, dates, and complete test matrices [37], [38]. | Press releases can support PR-level statements, but they do not prove full test coverage or certification scope without formal reports and test matrices [38]. |
| Measurement-performance comparison | Same-condition measurements for both products, including setup, channel/profile, bandwidth, frequency range, uncertainty, calibration conditions, software/firmware versions, and option stack; passages flag missing measurement conditions as unresolved in competitive and demo claims [10], [23]. | Without comparable conditions, numbers such as bandwidth, frequency, throughput, or capability claims can become unsupported or misleading [10]. |
| Market or customer-facing Automotive positioning | Dated market evidence or customer adoption evidence; Market claims should avoid “currently” and should be tied to a date/source, and missing items must be marked as unresolved rather than inferred [15], [35]. | Market news, competitor dynamics, and customer adoption are separate from technical capability and must be traceable to dated sources [14], [15]. |
### Bottom line
Use no Automotive competitor comparison until you have a direct source tying the oscilloscope solution, the named competitor product, the Automotive use case, and the exact measured or specified criteria into one supported comparison; the current passages provide only an oscilloscope option fact for R&S FSW-B2071 and do not provide that comparison [4], [100].

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。

- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。

- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。

- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。

- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

cetecom advanced
[[cetecom advanced]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中列名的 independent test laboratory，來源稱其為多領域產品測試與 worldwide certification 機構。

cetecom advanced › 來源中的定位
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing of the Rohde & Schwarz hybrid eCall and Next Generation eCall test solution。
- 來源稱 cetecom advanced is a leading independent test laboratory for product testing and worldwide certification。

- [[Thomas Reschka]] 以 Senior Technical Consultant at cetecom advanced 身分在新聞稿中被引用。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 與 NGeCall over LTE / NR-LTE 的關係
[[NGeCall over LTE]] 與 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] 關注 NG eCall 在 IMS / packet-switched 4G/5G 路徑上的測試支援與標準對照。[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 進一步把 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 multi-path robustness 放在同一驗證範圍內。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿，說明 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，以 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] 驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification]]。

R&S FSW8 › Sensitivity 摘錄
- Displayed average noise level 條件：RF attenuation = 0 dB、termination = 50 Ω、normalized to 1 Hz RBW、RBW = 1 kHz、VBW = 1 Hz、+5 °C to +40 °C。
- RF preamplifier off：2 Hz ≤ f ≤ 100 Hz 為 –110 dBm，typ. –120 dBm；1 MHz < f ≤ 1 GHz 為 –150 dBm，typ. –154 dBm；3 GHz ≤ f ≤ 8 GHz 為 –152 dBm，typ. –156 dBm。
- With R&S FSW-B24、RF preamplifier = 30 dB：50 MHz < f ≤ 150 MHz 為 –163 dBm，typ. –166 dBm；150 MHz < f ≤ 8 GHz 為 –166 dBm，typ. –169 dBm。
- 若安裝 R&S FSW-B25，來源列示值加 1 dB。

R&S FSW8 › Software / firmware licences
- Firmware options 依 [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701]] 的 ordering information；報價前需檢查各 option 的 requires/excludes。
- WLAN K95/K97 需 R&S FSW-B2001/-B800R/-B4001/-B6001/-B8001 option，因此不能直接推論適用 R&S FSW8。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › Demo 主張
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]]：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源把 13 GHz 歸入 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range。
- 來源定義 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- DUT / platform 端為 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 [[5G]] mobile test platform（MTP）。
- Test equipment 端使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]。
- Use case 是 maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱成果 confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 展示活動
來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 將在 [[MWC 2025 Barcelona]] 共同展示 high-performance setup for early [[FR3]] research featuring [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]：

- 地點：Fira Gran Via in Barcelona。
- Hall：5。
- Booth：5A80。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › CMX500 OBT 在來源中的角色
來源稱 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 是 future-proof multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester，且其 versatility allows for easy adaptation to different [[NR]] numerologies，因此適合 [[FR3]] research and development。

在此 demonstration 中，來源列出 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的兩個功能：

- Create a signaling environment by transmitting an [[FR3]] cell signal at 13 GHz, simulating real-world conditions。
- Conduct comprehensive analysis, verifying the device's ability to achieve maximum throughput in the [[FR3]] frequency range。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft]]、[[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 同屬 2026-02-26 R&S battle card 類型來源；三者都應視為競品銷售定位，而不是正式規格來源。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式規格仍需以 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（Version 11.00，August 2025）與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]（Version 32，CSW 9.20.0 and higher）追溯。
- 本來源提到 [[R&S CMW500]] covers all legacy + EN-DC；[[R&S CMW500]] 的正式資料需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 本來源新增 [[Keysight]] 在 wireless device testing battle card 語境中的公司與 UXM portfolio 描述；既有 [[Keysight]] 頁主要來自高頻高速 PCB 測試圖像來源，兩者資料層次不同。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 測試與市場語彙
- [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[FR3]]、[[6G]]、[[Wi-Fi 6]]、[[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]]、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]]、[[IMS]]、[[VoNR]]、[[VoWiFi]]、[[Fading]]、[[Doppler]]、[[Satellite mobility]]、[[IP throughput testing]]、[[Application testing]]、[[Operator Certification]]、[[PTCRB]]、[[RRM]]、[[PCT]]。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 於 2026-02-26 標示的 **R&S CMX500 vs. Keysight – Battle Card (2026)**，性質是 sales battle card / competitive positioning，不是 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[Keysight]] UXM 產品的 binding specifications。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有頁面的矛盾 / 需並列標註
⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] cellular FR1 up to **18 GHz**、FR2 up to **50 GHz (RRH evo)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit frequency range **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**，[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF generator **6 GHz to 20 GHz**、IF analyzer **4 GHz to 20 GHz**，FR2 remote radio heads 為 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]]。判斷：battle card 可能將 FR1 / FR3 / RFU18 roadmap 口徑混寫；正式規格比較不得直接引用 quick table 的 FR1 up to 18 GHz，需等待 RFU18 或 FR3 正式規格文件。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 [[RFU18]] 提供 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF bandwidth **250 MHz**、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF analyzer bandwidth up to **1 GHz**，且 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 說 IF unit 最高 **800 MHz total carrier bandwidth**、NR FR2 channel bandwidth **50 / 100 / 200 / 400 MHz**。判斷：2000 MHz 屬 RFU18 / roadmap sales claim，不可回填為既有 CMX500 binding specification。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

Market 類資料 › 新聞與名單處理
依 [[Market README]]：

cetecom advanced › 與 R&S eCall 測試方案的關係
[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 solution 通過 cetecom advanced certification testing。該 solution 以 [[R&S CMX500]] 為基礎，並使用更新後的 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] eCall evaluation solution，以支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。
- 來源宣稱 users can test all NTN technologies on both network and device level without multiple instruments。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] booth 5A80 / hall 5 展示 upgraded one-box tester，活動期間為 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-05。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Comprehensive support for NR-NTN。
- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Complete channel emulation in one box。
- Live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters。
- NB-NTN coming end of `25。
- Option 線索：[[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

此處的 one-box tester 是 PR / solution positioning 與簡報 use-case 語彙；正式 hardware configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 與 order number 仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]] 與正式 configurator。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Qualcomm
[[Qualcomm]] 是 [[Taiwan CPE Industry 2024]] 中列於 2024 年 [[5G FWA]] [[CPE]] upstream chipset / RF supply chain 與 chipset competitive landscape 的公司名稱；來源未標示完整法律實體，因此暫不自動等同 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 或 [[Qualcomm Incorporated]]。

O-RU tester market and funding › Competitor positioning
依來源 Slide 17–20：

- Main competitors offering O-RU conformance testers：[[Keysight]]、[[LitePoint]]、[[Anritsu]]。
- 來源稱 [[Keysight]] 是 O-RU testing market majority both R&D / productions；此為 R&S internal sales statement，未提供市場份額報告。
- [[LitePoint]] 被描述為 offers integrated O-DU emulator + VSG + VSA。
- [[Anritsu]] 被描述為 offers O-RU testing solution based on O-DU emulator，very minority / no market share；此為 R&S internal statement，需 Anritsu 官方或第三方市場資料補證。
- Keysight hardware comparison 提到 [[Keysight Time Sync Analyzer]]、MTRX、O-DU emulator、10 / 25 / 100GE Ethernet interfaces、GNSS receiver、ToD input、Rubidium option 與 VSA frequency / time error measurement requirement。
- VIAVI / R&S vs Keysight comparison 中列出 price point、test coverage、M-MIMO with BFM、functional test、TCO、reusability 與 TM500 performance test 等 sales comparison；不可當成競品規格驗證。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

- [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 的 AUX IF output、RX power output、AUX IF input 與 connector 資訊。
- [[R&S QAT100]] 搭配 [[R&S AREG800A]] 的 IF level 與 amplitude flatness 摘要。
- 讀圖補充 p001、p021、p022、p023 的低可信度註記。
- `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` 條件、RF transfer characteristics 中未完整保留 option code 的 unresolved 記錄。

本來源與其他 Rohde & Schwarz Productions 頁面（如 [[R&S SGU100A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]）同屬 test & measurement 產品資料，但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

5G NTN validation and testing
[[5G NTN validation and testing]] 是針對 [[5G Non-Terrestrial Networks]]、[[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]] 與 satellite connectivity devices，在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下驗證 satellite connectivity behavior、radio channel modelling、orbit / channel emulation、protocol / performance / RF scenarios 與 system-level behavior 的測試活動。[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 補充一個 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示例子：以 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 則補入 [[Viasat]] / [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 [[NB-NTN]] [[IoT]] certification test plan 語境，焦點是 device validation、interoperability with [[Viasat]] satellite network 與 [[3GPP Release 17]] compliance。

R&S CMX500 OBT › MWC 2024 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 展示語境
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：

- 展示使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[MediaTek]] 的 NTN-NR device as DUT。
- 展示內容為 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection，emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] radio communication tester 在 setup 中 simulate the satellite base station。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator 在 setup 中以 integrated GNSS option simulate the different satellite constellations。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 會 operate in an interactive callbox mode，allowing users to trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。
- 來源定位此 test mode 為評估 future NTN-NR devices powered by [[MediaTek]] NTN test platform 在不同條件下的 5G connection performance and reliability。

此段只可作為 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示 / PR 層級證據；不能取代 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 或 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。

- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio

### Short answer
The passages do not support a comparison between “our Oscilloscope solution” and any competitor for Automotive; the only oscilloscope-related fact provided is that R&S FSW-B2071 is an “Oscilloscope baseband inputs” hardware option applicable to all FSW models, with no Automotive or competitor comparison stated [4].
### Evidence required before making the comparison
| To claim | Required evidence | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Our oscilloscope solution is suitable for Automotive | A cited product document, application note, solution note, or test setup that directly connects the oscilloscope solution to Automotive use cases; the current Automotive product evidence is for R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, not an oscilloscope solution [60]. | Automotive fit cannot be inferred from separate product facts; the passages require a cited source directly connecting the relevant comparison facets, and separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. |
| Our oscilloscope solution has specific capabilities | Binding specifications with model, option code, version/date, measurement conditions, tolerance limits, and calibration/environment conditions; formal product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-binding data [49]. | Non-binding data and sales descriptions cannot be used as guaranteed technical claims; CMX500 feature data, for example, is “subject to change” and data without tolerance limits is not binding [49]. |
| Competitor product capabilities | Competitor official datasheets, features documents, configuration guides, release notes, or third-party test reports for the exact competitor model/version; R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [32]. | The passages warn that R&S internal battle-card claims about competitors require official competitor documents or third-party evidence before use in customer material [75]. |
| Any “better than,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” claim | Formal evidence such as datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools, validated test reports, or a documented TCO calculation; battle-card sales language is not a verifiable technical specification [12]. | The passages explicitly say “only,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability,” and “lower TCO” must be checked against formal evidence before technical comparison or customer use [12]. |
| Automotive test coverage or certification | Test report, certificate number, certification body role, test date, standard version, test case IDs, pass/fail criteria, and scope; eCall-related passages note missing certificate numbers, report numbers, dates, and complete test matrices [37], [38]. | Press releases can support PR-level statements, but they do not prove full test coverage or certification scope without formal reports and test matrices [38]. |
| Measurement-performance comparison | Same-condition measurements for both products, including setup, channel/profile, bandwidth, frequency range, uncertainty, calibration conditions, software/firmware versions, and option stack; passages flag missing measurement conditions as unresolved in competitive and demo claims [10], [23]. | Without comparable conditions, numbers such as bandwidth, frequency, throughput, or capability claims can become unsupported or misleading [10]. |
| Market or customer-facing Automotive positioning | Dated market evidence or customer adoption evidence; Market claims should avoid “currently” and should be tied to a date/source, and missing items must be marked as unresolved rather than inferred [15], [35]. | Market news, competitor dynamics, and customer adoption are separate from technical capability and must be traceable to dated sources [14], [15]. |
### Bottom line
Use no Automotive competitor comparison until you have a direct source tying the oscilloscope solution, the named competitor product, the Automotive use case, and the exact measured or specified criteria into one supported comparison; the current passages provide only an oscilloscope option fact for R&S FSW-B2071 and do not provide that comparison [4], [100].

cetecom advanced › 來源中的定位
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 與 NGeCall over LTE / NR-LTE 的關係
[[NGeCall over LTE]] 與 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] 關注 NG eCall 在 IMS / packet-switched 4G/5G 路徑上的測試支援與標準對照。[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 進一步把 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 multi-path robustness 放在同一驗證範圍內。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

### Short answer
The passages do not support a comparison between “our Oscilloscope solution” and any competitor for Automotive; the only oscilloscope-related fact provided is that R&S FSW-B2071 is an “Oscilloscope baseband inputs” hardware option applicable to all FSW models, with no Automotive or competitor comparison stated [4].
### Evidence required before making the comparison
| To claim | Required evidence | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Our oscilloscope solution is suitable for Automotive | A cited product document, application note, solution note, or test setup that directly connects the oscilloscope solution to Automotive use cases; the current Automotive product evidence is for R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, not an oscilloscope solution [60]. | Automotive fit cannot be inferred from separate product facts; the passages require a cited source directly connecting the relevant comparison facets, and separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. |
| Our oscilloscope solution has specific capabilities | Binding specifications with model, option code, version/date, measurement conditions, tolerance limits, and calibration/environment conditions; formal product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-binding data [49]. | Non-binding data and sales descriptions cannot be used as guaranteed technical claims; CMX500 feature data, for example, is “subject to change” and data without tolerance limits is not binding [49]. |
| Competitor product capabilities | Competitor official datasheets, features documents, configuration guides, release notes, or third-party test reports for the exact competitor model/version; R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [32]. | The passages warn that R&S internal battle-card claims about competitors require official competitor documents or third-party evidence before use in customer material [75]. |
| Any “better than,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” claim | Formal evidence such as datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools, validated test reports, or a documented TCO calculation; battle-card sales language is not a verifiable technical specification [12]. | The passages explicitly say “only,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability,” and “lower TCO” must be checked against formal evidence before technical comparison or customer use [12]. |
| Automotive test coverage or certification | Test report, certificate number, certification body role, test date, standard version, test case IDs, pass/fail criteria, and scope; eCall-related passages note missing certificate numbers, report numbers, dates, and complete test matrices [37], [38]. | Press releases can support PR-level statements, but they do not prove full test coverage or certification scope without formal reports and test matrices [38]. |
| Measurement-performance comparison | Same-condition measurements for both products, including setup, channel/profile, bandwidth, frequency range, uncertainty, calibration conditions, software/firmware versions, and option stack; passages flag missing measurement conditions as unresolved in competitive and demo claims [10], [23]. | Without comparable conditions, numbers such as bandwidth, frequency, throughput, or capability claims can become unsupported or misleading [10]. |
| Market or customer-facing Automotive positioning | Dated market evidence or customer adoption evidence; Market claims should avoid “currently” and should be tied to a date/source, and missing items must be marked as unresolved rather than inferred [15], [35]. | Market news, competitor dynamics, and customer adoption are separate from technical capability and must be traceable to dated sources [14], [15]. |
### Bottom line
Use no Automotive competitor comparison until you have a direct source tying the oscilloscope solution, the named competitor product, the Automotive use case, and the exact measured or specified criteria into one supported comparison; the current passages provide only an oscilloscope option fact for R&S FSW-B2071 and do not provide that comparison [4], [100].
